findings.obligation: P10 semantic RED for the Refinement Parent cut; P10 tooltip for long text
findings.observation: The test waits only for the Work Item text, never the parent title. useParentWorkItems loads parents asynchronously (hooks/useParentWorkItems.ts:24, featureService.getFeaturesByReferences at :42), and ParentWorkItemCell.tsx:37 renders the bare reference when the parent is not yet in the map. The failing assertion can fire on an unloaded reference id, not on a missing cut. The Parent tooltip is not asserted at all.
findings.remediation: Before the cut check, await the parent title as the cell displays it (findByText). Keep the cut check on that cell. Add a hover and a focus check that the tooltip shows the parent title, not the reference id. Re-observe RED for this check.

findings.remediation: Add an uncut negative per table, or cite the S1 DataGridBase tooltip case that covers it; document in the kit that the cut is a stated input.
